## Checklist

- [ ] Ran `pytest tests/ -x` and it passes (or noted any skipped tests and why).
- [ ] Ran `docker compose up --build` and confirmed the stack still ingests a file end-to-end.
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `## [Unreleased]` if user-visible.
- [ ] Updated `docs/architecture.md` if the shape of a layer changed.
- [ ] Updated `examples/akopia.yaml.example` if a config field was added.
- [ ] Added or updated tests that cover the change (if the change is testable).
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (see CONTRIBUTING.md).
